title: Transactional Writing: Letters, Emails and Notices
summary: Formats and register for formal and friendly letters, emails, notices, invitations and agendas, with the Grade 10 length of 120–150 words.

notes.text: Transactional texts are written for a **practical purpose** and a specific **audience**: to request, complain, inform, invite or apply. Correct **format** and **register** are marked as well as content. A Grade 10 transactional text is usually **120–150 words** (body only).

items: Sender's address (top right or top left) and date.
Body: introduction (purpose), development, conclusion (what you want done).
Closing: 'Yours faithfully' (if you used Sir/Madam) or 'Yours sincerely' (if you used a name), signature and full name.

notes.text: Has the sender's address and date, an informal salutation ('Dear Gogo'), a chatty, personal tone, and a warm closing ('Lots of love'). Contractions and informal language are acceptable, but spelling must still be correct.

rows: To, Cc, Subject line; greeting; short paragraphs; sign-off; formal or informal depending on the reader
Heading; who, what, when, where; contact details; issued by and date
Host, occasion, date, time, venue, dress code, RSVP
Name of organisation, date, time, venue; numbered items: welcome, apologies, minutes of previous meeting, matters arising, new business, general, closure

notes.title: Formal letter opening
notes.problem: Write the first lines of a letter of complaint about a faulty phone.
steps: RE: COMPLAINT ABOUT A FAULTY CELLPHONE
I am writing to complain about a Novo X5 cellphone that I bought from your Menlyn store on 2 March, which stopped working after one week.
notes.answer: Purpose stated clearly in the first sentence, with facts (product, place, date, problem).

notes.title: Writing a notice
notes.problem: Write a notice for a school cake sale on Friday at break.
steps: Include what, when, where and who to contact.
notes.answer: 'CAKE SALE. Friday, first break, school hall. Cakes from R5. Enquiries: Ms Khumalo.'

questions.prompt: What should the first paragraph of a formal letter do?
questions.memo:

questions.prompt: Rewrite formally: 'Your bus driver was super rude to my kid, not cool!'

questions.prompt: List FOUR details that a notice about a school book fair must contain.
